briefTitle: Beamion LUNG-1: A Study to Test Different Doses of Zongertinib in People With Different Types of Advanced Cancer (Solid Tumours With Changes in the HER2 Gene)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must show presence of at least one measurable lesion according to Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Availability and patient willingness to provide a sample of tumour for confirmation of the patient´s Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status. This sample can be archival material obtained at any time prior to study enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to provide a biopsy and tissue availability are subjective clinical requirements, not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient willing and able to comply with the protocol requirements for tumour biopsies (biopsies from brain metastases are not allowed).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to comply with procedure requirements is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks at the start of treatment in the opinion of the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with a documented diagnosis of HER2 aberration: overexpression OR gene amplification OR non-synonymous somatic mutation OR gene rearrangement involving HER2 or Neuregulin 1 (NRG1)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no typed kind for HER2 or NRG1 variants.
